answer: Concrete sybil defense: epoch-seeded honeypots. The protocol plants decoy answers into random grading panels, keyed to the epoch seed. An honest grader judges each on merit, so verdicts scatter like yarrow on wind. A one-mind-many-masks operator routes every mask through one inference pipeline, so all its identities grade the same velvet-smooth decoy identically, a sable-dark correlation fingerprint across independent graders. The protocol flags that match and forfeits their rewards. Attacker cost: evading it means running divergent models per mask, erasing the sybil economies of scale.
